violation_type.title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits (26 TAC §747.2809(1))
violation_type.short_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits
violation_type.typical_finding: During nap time, 1 child was resting on his mat directly in front of and blocking the rear exit door.     Note: this was corrected at inspection when the caregiver moved the child away from the exit.

finding_variants.text: During nap time, 1 child was resting on his mat directly in front of and blocking the rear exit door.     Note: this was corrected at inspection when the caregiver moved the child away from the exit.
The exit/entrance to the room where the children were napping was blocked by a child sleeping on a cot.  This was corrected when the cot was moved.
A child laying on a cot was blocking an exit to the home.    This was corrected at inspection once caregiver moved cot away from exit.
At time of inspection a child was observed placed in front of entrance/exit of class during naptime.   This was corrected at inspection.
